name: Jausenstation Schrandlhof
beschreibung: Jausenstation Schrandlhof is situated on a sunny hillside in Westendorf in the Brixen Valley, surrounded by the picturesque Kitzbühel Alps. This popular mountain inn combines alpine authenticity with a panoramic sun terrace and warm family hospitality. Hikers, skiers, and day-trippers delight in homemade Tyrolean dishes, including savory cheese spätzle, fluffy caramelized Kaiserschmarrn, and hearty cold cut platters prepared with local farm ingredients. In winter, guests enjoy direct access to the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental slopes, while summer brings scenic alpine trails through the valley.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional mountain inn in Westendorf in the Brixen Valley featuring authentic Tyrolean dining and a sun terrace.
